summary: Three focused plugins guide file inspection, task-wide aggregation and evidence-based field selection. This earlier promoted checkpoint outscored the campaign final in retrospective tests.
summary_zh: 三个插件分别指导文件检查、全局统计和基于真实样本的字段判断。这个已晋升的早期检查点在回溯补测中高于原最终版。

responsibilities.inspection-contract: Inspect relevant files and schema before choosing a command.
responsibilities.global-projection: Preserve task-wide aggregation and projection semantics.
responsibilities.sample-evidence: Ground fields and delimiters in actual sampled contents.
